summary: Performs an atomic operation on an explicitly bound run-scoped live table. Existing variables remain snapshots until read again.
execution_note: Requires an admitted live-table binding. Unmanaged runs and replay fail closed without an explicit isolated seed. Leases permit redelivery; they do not make external work exactly once.

fields.name: params.alias
fields.doc: Static alias of a trusted run binding; never a remote URL or table credential.
fields.label: Table alias

fields.name: params.result_prefix
fields.doc: Static var namespace prefix. Row fields appear under <prefix>.values.<column>; metadata includes status, revision, record_id and record_version. Bounded ranges use JSON rows/cells/columns. Missing results clear prior outputs. For lease, also identifies the private lease reference.
fields.label: Save results as

fields.name: params.record_id
fields.doc: Stable native record ID; templates allowed.
fields.label: Record ID

fields.name: params.position
fields.doc: One-based position for operations supporting positional access.
fields.label: Position

fields.name: params.columns
fields.doc: Distinct static column identifiers. Required for column operations.
fields.label: Columns

fields.name: params.values
fields.doc: Column-to-string values. Missing keys remain absent; empty strings remain present. Managed secrets are prohibited.
fields.label: Values

fields.name: params.expected
fields.doc: Expected column values for supported conditional operations.
fields.label: Only when the row has

fields.name: params.expected_version
fields.doc: Required native update version as a positive decimal string or template.
fields.label: Expected version

fields.name: params.delta
fields.doc: Signed 64-bit increment, as a number or a decimal string; overflow and nonnumeric cells fail.
fields.label: Add

fields.name: params.lease_ref
fields.doc: Private lease reference created by an earlier lease action's result_prefix. Tokens are never exposed as variables.
fields.label: Lease

fields.name: params.lease_ms
fields.doc: Lease/renew duration, at most 300000 ms; zero uses the admitted binding duration.
fields.label: Lease for

fields.name: params.wait_ms
fields.doc: Bounded empty-table wait for read/next/pop/lease, at most 60000 ms.
fields.label: Wait for a row up to

fields.name: params.limit
fields.doc: Maximum range rows or column cells returned, at most 1000.
fields.label: Rows to return

fields.name: params.cursor
fields.doc: Named shared sequential cursor for next; omitted uses the table-wide cursor.
fields.label: Shared cursor

fields.name: params.on_empty
fields.doc: Empty/missing result policy; defaults to error. Outputs are cleared in either case.
fields.label: When no row is found

fields.name: params.on_condition
fields.doc: Failed comparison policy; defaults to error.
fields.label: When the row does not match

variants.label: Read a row by ID or position
variants.summary: Reads one row, or a range from a position, without changing the table.

variants.label: Read the next row
variants.summary: Reads the row after the shared cursor and moves the cursor on, leaving the row in the table.

variants.label: Read a column
variants.summary: Reads the cells of one column.

variants.label: Add a row
variants.summary: Adds a row with the values given.

variants.label: Update a row
variants.summary: Changes a row's values, if it still has the version (or, by position, the cells) you expect.

variants.label: Add to a number
variants.summary: Adds to an integer cell, atomically.

variants.label: Clear cells in a row
variants.summary: Removes the given cells (or all of them) from the row at a position.

variants.label: Remove the next row
variants.summary: Takes the next row out of the table; no other VUser gets it.

variants.label: Lease a row
variants.summary: Takes the next row for a while; acknowledge it when done, or it is delivered again.

variants.label: Renew a lease
variants.summary: Extends a lease taken by an earlier step.

variants.label: Acknowledge a lease
variants.summary: Finishes the leased row's work; the row leaves the table. If the iteration fails before this step, the lease expires and the row is delivered again.

variants.label: Release a lease
variants.summary: Gives the leased row back for another VUser.

variants.label: Add a column
variants.summary: Adds an empty column to the table.

variants.label: Rotate columns
variants.summary: Reads the first row and moves it to the end of its columns, so the next VUser reads the next one.
